title: Non-procedure document record (ROUND-4-DATA.md)
description: One JSON file per document at data/processed_docs/<kind>/<file>.json: a legal article, form, fee resolution, guidance page or change notice linked to existing procedures. Identifiers are English; content is Vietnamese verbatim (NFC). Checked by scripts/validate_documents.py and cleaned by scripts/clean_documents.py.

kind.description: Must equal the <kind> directory the file sits in.

issuer.description: e.g. "Chính phủ", "Bộ Tư pháp", "HĐND tỉnh Đắk Lắk"

jurisdiction.description: Province for fee_resolution / provincial guidance (e.g. "Đắk Lắk"); null or absent = national

url.description: The official page or file the text was taken from

retrieved_at.description: ISO YYYY-MM-DD (a full ISO timestamp is accepted and truncated)

sha256.description: sha256 of the fetched raw bytes (the cached response), lower-case hex. Provenance only: per-article documents cut from one file share it

text_sha256.description: Written by scripts/clean_documents.py (collectors need not emit it): sha256 of the NFC, whitespace-collapsed section headings and texts; de-duplication key

procedure_ids.description: Existing procedure_ids this document is about; each must exist in the procedure records

link_method.description: How procedure_ids were found: the record's legal_basis cites it / the page names the procedure code / data/doc_links.yaml / hand-set (say why in notes) / the document names the procedure / the procedure falls within the instrument's scope (change notices; per-link reason in notes)

heading.description: e.g. "Điều 16. Đăng ký khai sinh"; for a form: "Tờ khai" / "Hướng dẫn điền"

original_version.description: legal_text or form: true = this is the original wording of an article / form that has since been amended (see amended_by); chunks are then prefixed "[Văn bản gốc – đã sửa đổi] "

amended_by.description: legal_text or form: the instruments that amended / replaced this article or form, e.g. ["Nghị định 120/2025/NĐ-CP, Điều 4"]

notes.description: Free text, e.g. relevance or why a manual link
